title: Improving Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Systems with Group Similarity Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2510.04392v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains where users expect outputs to be consistent across semantically equivalent queries. However, existing systems often exhibit significant inconsistencies due to variability in both the retriever and generator, undermining trust and reliability. In this work, we focus on information consistency, i.e., the requirement that generated outputs convey the same core content across semantically equivalent inputs. We introduce a principled evaluation framework that decomposes RAG consistency into retriever-level, generator-level, and end-to-end components, enabling systematic identification of inconsistency sources. To improve consistency, we propose Paraphrased Set Group Relative Policy Optimization (PS-GRPO), an RL approach that leverages multiple rollouts across paraphrased set to assign group similarity rewards. translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统越来越多地被部署在高风险领域，用户期望其输出在语义等价的查询之间保持一致。然而，由于检索器和生成器双方均存在变异性，现有系统常常表现出显著的不一致性，损害了信任与可靠性。在这项工作中，我们关注信息一致性，即生成的输出在语义等价的输入之间应传达相同核心内容的要求。我们引入了一个有原则性的评估框架，将RAG一致性分解为检索器级别、生成器级别和端到端组件，从而能够系统地识别不一致性的来源。为了提升一致性，我们提出了复述集组相对策略优化（PS-GRPO），这是一种强化学习方法，通过在复述集上进行多次rollout来分配组相似度奖励。我们利用PS-GRPO来实现
tldr: 本文提出PS-GRPO强化学习方法，通过跨复述集的组相似度奖励来提升RAG系统在语义等价查询下的信息一致性，并提供了将一致性分解为检索器、生成器和端到端层面的系统性评估框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PS-GRPO, a reinforcement learning approach that assigns group similarity rewards across paraphrased sets to improve information consistency in RAG systems, together with a principled evaluation framework that decomposes consistency into retriever-level, generator-level, and end-to-end components.
